item.text:
Provides shop-order helpers: calculates line-item totals, applies two discount codes, computes an average, and formats an order receipt.

Bugs:

- `calcTotal` loops with `i <= items.length`; final iteration reads `items[items.length]` (undefined) and throws. Use `i < items.length`.
- `averageItemPrice` divides the quantity-weighted total by number of line items, so it is not an average item/unit price when quantities differ; divide by total quantity if that is intended.
- `averageItemPrice([])` returns `NaN` (and currently throws first because of `calcTotal`); empty orders need defined handling.
